experiences.description:
•Train new routers on all aspects of logistics routing.
•Provide picking and packing reporting to management on a daily basis.
•Work directly with new customer base to ensure they are properly set up in the systems and are scheduled appropriately.

•Personal training for gym members in group setting.
•Membership sales
•Reviewed and submitted project estimates to appropriate project manager.

•	Account for and organize merchandise, props and grip equipment for photography shoots.
•	Work with photo studio team to identify any damaged and/or missing samples leading up to their photo shoots.
•	Communicate the outstanding sample list to producer/studio manager and work with brand merchants to solve problems.
•	Understand multiple schedules, calendar deadlines and prioritize work accordingly.
•	Load and unload merchandise, props and equipment between warehouse and photo studio.
•	Assist with rigging, painting, assembling merchandise, prop prep and set prep and breakdown.
•	Repack photo samples and props in original containers.
•	Maintain a professional demeanor with photo team and vendors.
•	Perform additional duties and errands as assigned by photography team.
